title: How to Correct and Modify Your BVN Details Online (2026 Guide)
excerpt: Need to change the name, phone number, or date of birth on your BVN? Learn how to submit your BVN modification request online using Ufriends IT and skip bank queues.

sections.content: You log into your mobile banking app to execute an important transfer, only to see a screen alert: "Your account has been temporarily restricted due to a BVN detail mismatch." Or you try to link your National Identification Number (NIN) to your bank account, and the system rejects it because your BVN date of birth (DOB) shows a different year. This is one of the most frustrating experiences a bank customer in Nigeria can face, especially when urgent transactions are pending. Suddenly, your hard-earned funds are inaccessible, and your business operations or personal obligations are put on hold, leaving you with delayed projects and unnecessary administrative stress, requiring immediate and fast actions to resolve.

A detail mismatch on your Bank Verification Number (BVN) is one of the most common reasons bank accounts are restricted in Nigeria. If the spelling of your name, your phone number, or your birth date on the bank's database does not match your official government ID, the central bank’s automatic compliance system flags it as suspicious. This security measure, while protecting the financial ecosystem from fraud, can lock out legitimate customers due to simple typographical mistakes made during their initial enrollment. Often, these errors were made years ago by busy bank customer service officers when the BVN system was first introduced.

Traditionally, resolving this issue meant taking a whole day off, getting a physical court affidavit, and queueing at the customer service desk of the specific bank branch where you first registered your BVN. Fortunately, you no longer have to face long queues and stressful bank audits. Using the secure, automated portal of Ufriends IT, you can submit your details and modify your BVN records online from your phone or computer. This guide will walk you through the entire process, detail the documents you need, and show you how to unblock your account fast, explaining both the online pathway and the standard requirements.

sections.content: What is BVN Modification on Ufriends IT?

BVN modification on Ufriends IT is a secure digital service that updates your demographic records (such as your Name, Date of Birth, or Phone Number) in the central NIBSS (Nigeria Inter-Bank Settlement System) database. Because your biometrics are already registered, there is no need to capture your fingerprints again. The platform acts as a secure intermediary, submitting your verified legal documents and details to NIBSS through authorized banking channels to update your profile centrally. This service is designed to bring relief to thousands of Nigerians who cannot afford the time to sit through tedious banking audits.

Instead of visiting bank halls, you submit your legal documents and details online. The Ufriends IT portal verifies the information, uploads the documents, and updates your central NIBSS profile, syncing it across all commercial banks linked to your BVN. This saves you from having to visit multiple banks if you hold multiple bank accounts. Once updated centrally, every bank you run an account with receives the new data feed, allowing them to re-verify your identity and lift restrictions automatically.
Why Details Must Match (NIBSS Compliance Rules)

The Nigeria Inter-Bank Settlement System (NIBSS) is the central infrastructure that facilitates payments and identity verification across all Nigerian banks. When the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) mandated that every BVN must be linked to a NIN, it introduced automated cross-validation filters. If a bank attempts to link your BVN to your NIN and finds a single character mismatch (such as 'John' vs 'Jon' or '15-May-1990' vs '16-May-1990'), the linking process fails, and your bank is legally required to freeze your account to prevent identity theft. This directive is part of the regulatory effort to combat money laundering, terrorism financing, and general bank impersonation scams.

Therefore, keeping your BVN details aligned with your NIN is not optional; it is a regulatory requirement. Modifying errors on your BVN is the first step to ensuring your financial profile remains active, letting you make transfers, request loans, and upgrade transaction limits without compliance issues. If your bank details are mismatched, even new wallets like OPay, Palmpay, or Moniepoint will eventually flag your account, restricting your ability to carry out basic business operations.
Supported BVN Modification Options
Ufriends IT supports all standard modification types depending on the errors on your bank profile. You can select:

items: Change of Name: Designed for correcting spelling mistakes, adding a missing middle name, or updating your surname after marriage or change of religion. It ensures your name sequence matches your NIN.

Arrangement of Name: Select this if your names are spelled correctly but appear in the wrong order (e.g., your last name is listed as your first name, causing automated database queries to fail due to mismatched fields).

Correction of Date of Birth: Used to fix incorrect birth days, months, or years on your profile. NIBSS heavily validates these requests to ensure users are not attempting age reductions for civil service or athletic purposes.
Change of Phone Number: Updates the primary alert and verification telephone line linked to your bank profile, which is critical for receiving SMS OTPs for transaction approvals.
Combination Modifications: If you need to update multiple fields at once, the system allows combination updates, including Name & DOB, DOB & Phone, Name & Phone, and Name, DOB & Phone.

sections.content: Required Documents for BVN Modification

Before starting the online process, gather the required documents based on what you want to modify to ensure quick approval. NIBSS validators will reject any submissions that lack appropriate legal backing:

items: For Name Changes: A court affidavit signed by a commissioner for oaths, a national newspaper publication page announcing the name change, a marriage certificate (for married women), and your correct NIN slip.

For Date of Birth Changes: A statutory declaration of age (court affidavit), your correct NIN slip showing your true birth date, and an NPC birth certificate (or NPC Attestation of Birth for those born before 1992).
For Phone Number Changes: A SIM registration pack, a SIM swap receipt from your telecom provider, or a court affidavit of SIM ownership verifying the line belongs to you.

Supporting ID Document: You must select one identification type to prove your identity. The portal accepts NIN (input your 11-digit NIN) or alternative IDs (upload a clear image/PDF of Voter's Card, Driving License, or International Passport).

sections.content: The Slower Alternative: Visiting a Physical Bank Branch

If you choose the manual physical route, you must visit a branch of the commercial bank where you first enrolled for your BVN. If you registered at First Bank, you must go to a First Bank branch. You cannot modify it at GTBank, even if you have accounts there. You will need to bring physical copies of your court affidavits, newspaper publications, and IDs, fill out the paper BVN modification form, queue at the customer service desk, and capture your biometrics manually. This process often takes hours, requires transport costs, and is subject to local staff delays and network downtime.
What Happens After Submission?

Once you submit your request, a verification officer validates your uploaded documents against the NIBSS central database. The system processes the update on the back-end, and NIBSS updates the central database within 24 to 72 hours. Once updated, the changes will reflect across all bank accounts linked to that BVN. You can check the progress of your request from the 'History' tab on your dashboard.
Common Rejection Reasons and How to Avoid Them
To prevent NIBSS from rejecting your online BVN modification request, pay close attention to these common pitfalls:

items: Mismatched Spelling: If your court affidavit spells your name as 'Chidi' but your NIN slip displays 'Chidiebere', the system will reject it. Ensure all names align perfectly across all documents.
Blurry Document Uploads: NIBSS verification officers reject blurred, cropped, or dark pictures. Use a scan app on your phone to capture sharp, colored, well-lit images or PDFs.

Invalid Birth Certificates: For date of birth changes, local hospital cards or handwritten declaration papers are not accepted. You must provide an official certificate or attestation issued by the National Population Commission (NPC).
Duplicate BVN Attempts: Never attempt to register a new BVN. Doing so is illegal and will flag your profile for biometric fraud. Always modify the existing one.

sections.content: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

items: Can I modify my BVN details online? Yes, you can modify your BVN details (Name, DOB, or Phone Number) online using secure verification portals like Ufriends IT. You simply upload your documents, submit the request, and Ufriends handles the processing on the back-end.
How long does Ufriends IT take to process BVN modifications? Ufriends IT processes and updates your BVN records in the NIBSS database within 24 to 72 hours.
What supporting ID can I upload for my BVN change? The Ufriends IT portal accepts your 11-digit NIN, or clear photo/PDF uploads of your Voter's Card, Driving License, or International Passport.
Why was my modification request rejected? The most common reasons are mismatched spellings across documents, illegible photo uploads, or submitting hospital cards instead of NPC birth certificates.
Do I need to visit the bank after an online modification? Usually, no. Once NIBSS updates the central database, the changes automatically reflect across all banks linked to your BVN.
What is the funding fee on Ufriends IT? Ufriends IT charges a simple 1% fee on automated virtual bank transfers, with funds crediting in under 15 seconds.
How do I check my updated details? Once approved, you can log into Ufriends IT, select 'Print BVN Slip', and instantly download your updated slip showing your correct Name and DOB.
Can I change my BVN number? No, your BVN is linked to your biometrics for life. You can only correct the demographic details associated with the number.
What if I don't remember my original bank? You can retrieve your BVN slip on Ufriends IT to view your enrollment details, which shows the bank code where you registered.
Is the online process secure? Yes, Ufriends IT uses bank-grade encryption to protect your identity documents and personal information.
Can I modify details on behalf of my family? Yes, as long as you have their correct biometrics (NIN) and required legal documents (affidavits, NPC birth certificates) for the upload.

What if my bank account is already restricted? Once NIBSS updates your central BVN profile, your bank will automatically receive the updated data feed and lift the restriction, though some banks may require you to contact customer care to trigger a manual profile refresh.
